text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert - P2: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west1). Paging: Alex
Alex: got it. I'm oncall. Starting triage now, will update every 5. Maya I'll hand off if it needs deeper infra changes. :eyes:
Maya: joining. seeing a connection pool exhaustion pattern to cache tier; fallback to cpu-burst path which times out; correlating with a config push at ~11:02 UTC from autoscaler.
Alex: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:03:06Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream=cache timeout=1200ms status=502
2026-03-15T11:03:07Z WARN  request_id=abc124 fallback_to_cpu=true
```
Maya: hypothesis: cache overflow causing increased latency then 5xx. Working on increasing pool and rolling back the autoscaler change.
Tariq: product note — which customers are affected? Any dedicated customers on the affected pool? We need a customer-impact assessment before public comms.
Alex: checking -> 4 hosted tenants + 2 dedicated (redwood-test-account, acme-inc). Hosted users saw token-limited degraded responses; dedicated tenants impacted only if pinned to the affected pool (acme appears pinned).
Simone: ok. I'll draft status page and short customer note. Need exact impact lines, ETA, and avoidance of root-cause speculation. Jenna, legal, can you weigh in on wording re: customer data? :wave:
Jenna: confirm we must avoid implying data loss. Use "service degradation" and "investigating". No mention of configuration changes as cause until confirmed.
Simone: draft status (Status Page entry):
```
Summary: Intermittent 5xx errors and increased latency for generation API in us-west1.
Impact: Some requests may return errors or experience delays. A subset of hosted customers and specific dedicated pools may be affected.
Action: Our engineering team is investigating and implementing mitigations.
Updates: next update in 30 minutes or when we have an ETA.
```
Simone: draft tweet (thread starter):
```
We're investigating intermittent errors affecting the Generation API in US‑West. Our engineering team is working on a fix — we'll post updates here and on status.redwood.com. Sorry for the disruption.
```
Nina: for social/PR: prefer shorter tweet + link to status. For bigger customers we'll send an email. Simone pls share customer email draft.
Simone: customer email draft subject: "Service degradation: Generation API (US‑West)"
Body:
```
Hi —
We're aware of a service degradation impacting the Generation API in the US‑West region. Some requests may fail or be slower than usual. We're investigating and expect to have a mitigation within the hour.
What we're doing: applying a rollback to an autoscaler change and increasing cache connection pool size.
Who to contact: Support will update tickets; if you have a dedicated account flagged as impacted, we'll follow up directly.
Apologies for the inconvenience — team Redwood
```
Jenna: remove the clause mentioning rollback/changes until we confirm. Replace with "engineers are applying mitigation steps to restore service".
Simone: updated email body with Jenna's edit. Putting the confirmed-safe wording into status and email.
Maya: mitigation in progress — increasing pool + temp routing around cache node. Rolling in a patch 11:20 UTC.
Alex: handoff plan: I'm on for another 20m, then Maya will take the page for follow-through. Paging schedule noted.
IncidentBot: On-call handoff scheduled: Alex -> Maya at 1769992250
SupportBot: Created ticket #INC-4523 and annotated affected customers: acme-inc, redwood-test-account. Assigned to Support Team A.
Tariq: for public messaging approvals: Marketing + Legal need to sign off on the final status and tweet. Simone/Nina coordinate; Jenna will OK final copy.
Nina: quick checklist: 1) short tweet + link 2) status page + timeline 3) targeted email for affected customers 4) blog post reserved for postmortem
Simone: agreed. I'll push drafts into #marketing-drafts and @Nina for quick approval. Once Jenna confirms, we'll post.
Alex: update at 11:21 UTC: latency dropping, 5xx rate falling from 12% -> 3%. Continuing to monitor.
Maya: mitigation complete at 11:29 UTC; monitoring for regressions.
Simone: final public lines after Jenna approves:
Status page update -> mark "Identified and mitigated; monitoring" with a non-technical summary and "full postmortem forthcoming".
Tweet -> short resolution + link to status.
Customer email -> apologize + summary + direct support contact.
Jenna: approved the final status & tweet wording. No mention of internal config changes.
Nina: posting tweet now. Simone please confirm link to status.
Simone: tweet posted (link: https://twitter.com/redwoodinference/status/placeholder) :white_check_mark:
SupportBot: Notified affected customers via email template; tickets updated.
Alex: closing notes: will create postmortem draft later today with timeline, root cause, and action items. Maya will own infra followups. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks — handing over monitoring to Alex (on-call will see follow-up tasks).
IncidentBot: Thread closed at 1769994600 (incident status: mitigated — monitoring)
